definitions.full: H7460. raad [ רָעַד ] verb tremble, quake (Late Hebrew id. , Hiph`il shake (rare), רְעָדָה a trembling, shaking ; Arabic thunder (said of sky), VIII. tremble, quiver ; Ethiopic tremble ; Jewish-Aramaic רְעַד tremble, shake ); — Qal Imperfect 3feminine singular וַתִּרְעָ֑ד Psa 104:32 and it (the earth) trembleth at the gaze of ׳י , in theoph. Hiph`il Participle מַרְעִיד עָמַדְתִּי Dan 10:11 I stood trembling ; plural מַרְעִדִים Ezra 10:9 , with יָשַׁב .

occurrences.englishText: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together to Jerusalem within the three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the wide place in front of God’s house, trembling because of this matter, and because of the great rain.
He looks at the earth, and it trembles.
He said to me, “Daniel, you greatly beloved man, understand the words that I speak to you, and stand upright; for I have been sent to you, now.” When he had spoken this word to me, I stood trembling.
